channel.title: FinnBots — Word games
channel.description: Spell, guess and unscramble. Free FinnBots games you play in your browser.

item.title: BOTWORD — free five-letter word game
item.description: Guess the secret word in six tries. Free to play in your browser on a phone, tablet or laptop. No download, no sign-up.

item.title: SCRAMBOT — free word scramble game
item.description: Make words from six scrambled letters — then use all six. Free to play in your browser on a phone, tablet or laptop. No download, no sign-up.

item.title: SHAKEBOT — free word search game
item.description: Race the Bot to find words in a grid of letter dice. Free to play in your browser on a phone, tablet or laptop. No download, no sign-up.

item.title: Words with Bots — free crossword word game
item.description: Build words on the board and outscore the Bot. Free to play in your browser on a phone, tablet or laptop. No download, no sign-up.
